title: Question 6.2e: Calculating Sensitivity and Specificity
instruction: These are additional metrics that give us more detailed information about model performance.
reveal: Sensitivity (also called recall) measures how well the model finds positive cases - it's the proportion of actual positives that were correctly identified. Specificity measures how well the model finds negative cases - it's the proportion of actual negatives that were correctly identified. The `(double)` cast ensures we get decimal division instead of integer division (which would truncate to 0 or 1).
